description: This file contains SCSS mixins for creating various gradient backgrounds, including horizontal, vertical, directional, three-color, radial, and striped gradients, intended for styling themes in the SuiteCRM project.

methods.name: gradient-horizontal
methods.description: Creates a horizontal gradient background with customizable start and end colors and percentages.

methods.name: gradient-vertical
methods.description: Creates a vertical gradient background with customizable start and end colors and percentages.

methods.name: gradient-directional
methods.description: Creates a linear gradient in a specified direction (angle) with customizable start and end colors.

methods.name: gradient-horizontal-three-colors
methods.description: Creates a horizontal gradient with three colors and a specified midpoint.

methods.name: gradient-vertical-three-colors
methods.description: Creates a vertical gradient with three colors and a specified midpoint.

methods.name: gradient-radial
methods.description: Creates a radial gradient with inner and outer colors.

methods.name: gradient-striped
methods.description: Creates a striped gradient pattern at a specified angle and transparency.
